_comment: Strings of the shared PDF workspace (src/assets/pdf-workspace.js). 'en' is the base; every other language must define every key. {name} {n} {size} {limit} {pct} {deg} {max} {bad} are placeholders: keep them. No plural forms are needed on purpose: counts are written as 'label: number'.

en.err_password: This PDF is password-protected. Remove the password and try again.
en.err_load: The PDF engine could not be loaded. Reload the page and try again.
en.err_generic: This file could not be processed. Try another file, or check that it isn’t damaged.
en.too_large: “{name}” is too large to process in your browser (limit {limit}).
en.add_min: Add at least {n} files to continue.
en.split_help: Pages in this file: {n}. Use commas and dashes, like 1-3,5.
en.split_err: Enter pages like 1-3,5. Pages in this file: {max}.
en.compress_warn: This file was already well optimised, so its size did not reduce. Your original is probably the better choice.
en.p2i_err: A page is too large to render in this browser. Try the Standard quality.
en.p2i_info_one: 1 page exported as a PNG image.
en.p2i_info_zip: PNG images in one ZIP file: {n}
